ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel coverage with sparse <5% high-intensity (white/light grey) punctate features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid dark pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white circular clusters localized at the far left tip, far right tip, and scattered sparse white dots across the medial-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation; estimated wide interior angle of approximately 140 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 10-12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire superior boundary; distinctive jagged, non-uniform peaks and valleys ranging from 2-5 pixels in amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical orientation; left lobe shows a predominantly horizontal superior edge with convex inferior curvature; right lobe shows a linear diagonal sweep inclined at approximately 30 degrees from the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels on the distal edges of both lobes and mid-body of the right lobe, consistent with low-relief surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear disruptions visible on the upper quadrant of the left lobe and lower-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular excision/void on the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch; localized high-relief clusters (barnacles) at the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged indentation on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe creating a secondary notch-like feature.
